punchline: With the automatics dead, Gordon Cooper flew his capsule home by hand, guided by the stars and a wristwatch.
thirty_sec: On 15 May 1963 Gordon Cooper's Faith 7 lost its automatic controls late in a 22-orbit flight. He lined up the capsule himself by the stars and horizon, fired the retrorockets and landed close to the carrier Kearsarge.
question: Which automated task of yours would stop completely tomorrow if the tool failed?
key_contrast: When the clever layer fails, the basic layer must still exist.
